title: Well-balanced second-order approximation of the compressible atmospheric Euler equations
summary: We introduce a second-order approximation to the compressible atmospheric Euler equations with gravity that is invariant domain preserving and well-balanced with respect to rest states. The approximation is built upon discrete auxiliary states derived from a hydrostatic reconstruction of the density. These auxiliary states, together with an affine shift of the numerical state, provide local bounds needed for maintaining well-balancing and invariant domain preserving properties of the method. The numerical method is then verified and validated with analytic solutions, well-balancing tests,…
